belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that architectural contour curvilinear rectilinear does not reliably affect approach avoidance decisions enter. The evidence base (3 findings, 3 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of architectural contour curvilinear rectilinear, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of architectural contour curvilinear rectilinear on approach avoidance decisions enter replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.
